recordRef.description: A reference to a record in the same space. Record keys are unique per repo rather than per space, so a bare key cannot address a record in a space that aggregates many authors.

did.description: DID of the repo holding the referenced record.

rkey.description: Record key of the referenced record.

spaceRecordRef.description: A reference to a record in a named space, for pointing at something outside the space the pointer lives in.

space.description: The space holding the referenced record.

did.description: DID of the repo holding the referenced record.

rkey.description: Record key of the referenced record.

cid.description: The referenced record's CID as it stood when the reference was made.
